DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: $2.1B Patriot sale approval and Senate defense policy bill are the strongest state changes; executive sourcing order, Lockheed acquisition, drone HQ and defense-diplomacy items follow. Sports/crime 'defense' items excluded as noise.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Verified GDP/PMI prints (US 3.4%, Taiwan 14.36%, China Q3, PMIs) are highest-quality global growth signals; forecasts and local unemployment/laboratory items excluded.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Hormuz tanker/LNG attacks and OPEC+ output decision are highest materiality for global energy ETFs; Goldman forecast and oil price swings reflect transmission. Local gas-shortage items and stock-picking content deprioritized.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Only four distinct candidates; loan-default deadline, record private-credit defaults, Taiwan dollar outflows and Westpac NZ impairment are the material systemic signals. Personal-finance/advice items excluded.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Verified policy/approval changes (NC Medicaid expansion, Colorado work requirements, FDA gene-therapy and drug approvals, Medicare supplier contracts) rank above anecdotal Medicare cost narratives and stock-pick style items.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Ranked by verified state change, global transmission and corroboration: Kherson truce collapse and Iran war escalation/funded Patriot deals dominate; North Korea war-prep order and Somali piracy carry supply-chain risk; China bank ransomware (tied to North Korea) is a financial-system event. Speculative/promotional/local items excluded.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Verified central-bank actions (ECB hold+Lagarde exit, Canada hike, Fed hold, BoJ signal, Norway rates) and confirmed inflation prints rank highest; forecast/opinion and local GST items deprioritized.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: US shutdown-avoidance deal, Philippines M7.5 earthquake with tsunami warning, Bolivia emergency and Chile wildfires are verified, material shocks; election analysis and social-media/local flood items deprioritized.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold's one-year-low rebound, nosedive on tightening/Iran standoff, and 10-month-low crash are the dominant verified price moves; sports 'gold', smuggling and stock-short-interest items excluded.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Intel's record market-value loss and chip rout, Korea export/semiconductor surge, Quad chip supply plan and Nvidia Europe buildout are verified, globally transmitted events; local data-center zoning and stock-pick pieces deprioritized.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy changes (Canada EV tariff, China AI/biopharma export controls, US-Canada relief, Vietnam probe, Norwegian salmon relief) rank above election speculation and local pork-tariff items.
